papers.title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders
papers.authors: Kin Ian Lo
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, image retrieval, image generation
papers.affiliations: University College London
papers.intro: 本文在理想编码器框架下证明了双编码器绑定失败的三个条件性障碍——递归绑定的深度天花板、对比学习目标的激励节流、以及平滑性-绑定前沿——并通过对18个部署模型的测量表明，当前绑定失败并非维度或平滑性限制，而是激励和编码结构限制。

papers.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
papers.authors: Jiawei Xu, Zhilin Zhai, Jinrui Fang, Ruohan Xu, Mingfei Lu, Yi Zhang, Guanchu Wang, Tianlong Chen, Ying Ding
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image generation
papers.affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin; The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; University of Cambridge; University of Technology Sydney; The University of North Carolina at Charlotte
papers.intro: SEER提出了一种选择性视觉-文本压缩框架，通过将视觉扫描选择与文本检索视为统一推理过程中的工具调用，在保留视觉压缩效率的同时，仅对查询相关的图像进行精确文本检索，从而在长上下文推理中实现效率与精度的平衡。

papers.title: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
papers.authors: Sarthak Kamat, Adam Rashid, Satvik Sharma, Aseem Doriwala, Chelsea Finn, Phillip Isola, C. Karen Liu
papers.tags: pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, image generation
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, MIT, Scale AI
papers.intro: 本文提出Simulation Pre-training for Dexterity (SPD)框架，通过VR头显在仿真中收集75小时的多任务灵巧操作数据来预训练扩散Transformer策略，并在真实56自由度双臂灵巧机器人上仅用1-2小时微调即可超越从零训练的行为克隆策略，证明了仿真遥操作是真实世…

papers.title: Comprehensive Benchmarking of Deep Learning Architectures for Lung Cancer Histopathology
papers.authors: Hadi Hasan, Safaa Salman, Lama Sleem, Ralph Mouawad, Ali Chehab
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, semantic segmentation, YOLO, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: American University of Beirut
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个两阶段深度学习框架，在统一实验协议下系统比较了六种分类架构和四种分割架构在肺癌组织病理学分析中的性能，并将最优模型（YOLO11分类器 + DeepLabV3+分割器）级联为端到端流水线，为自动化组织病理学图像分析提供了准确、计算高效且可复现的基准。

papers.title: CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection
papers.authors: Yuchen Zhang, Shuang Dai, Zeyu Fu, Yunfei Long, Ravi Shekhar, Haralambos Mouratidis
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, CLIP
papers.affiliations: University of Essex, University of Exeter, Queen Mary University of London
papers.intro: CLARA提出了一种基于片段级别的多模态对齐框架，通过将视频建模为话语对齐的片段序列，结合MoE编码器、局部-全局对比学习和VLM推理来检测仇恨视频。

papers.title: MagViT: Interpretable Multi-Magnification Transformers with Patient-Level Model Selection for Breast Histopathology
papers.authors: Nabil Ashab, Soumit Kumar Kundu, Saif Mahmud Parvez, Shahadat Hossain Sohag, Bidhan Biswas, Nazmus Subha
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, vision transformer, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Dhaka International University（作者1-5）；TMSS Medical College（作者6）
papers.intro: 本文提出MagViT，一个基于尺度门控融合和患者级模型选择的可解释多放大倍率Transformer框架，通过掩码感知的跨倍率特征融合和患者级五折交叉验证，在BreakHis数据集上实现了患者级准确率0.9643，并在BUSI和IDC数据集上展示了初步的跨数据集泛化能力。

papers.title: ORViT-DR: Ordinally-Robust Hybrid ViT for Low-Resolution Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
papers.authors: Soumit Kumar Kundu, Nabil Ashab, Bidhan Biswas, Shahadat Hossain Sohag, Saif Mahmud Parvez, Souvik Kumar Kundu, Zunayed Ahmed Rafi
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, vision transformer

papers.title: FlowDance: Music-Driven Dance Video Generation with Parallel Pose and RGB Streams
papers.authors: Genying Li, Boda Lin, Jiachen Li, Zijian Jia, Haojie Zheng, Yiming Wang, Shuchen Weng, Si Li
papers.tags: pose estimation, image generation, diffusion model, video generation
papers.affiliations: 北京邮电大学人工智能学院、北京人工智能研究院、北京大学软件与微电子学院
papers.intro: FlowDance提出了一种并行姿态流与RGB流的音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成框架，通过时间步感知的姿态注入和持久身份注入，在统一扩散模型中同时实现显式运动建模和参考保持的视觉合成，并构建了大规模野外舞蹈视频数据集FlowDanceSet。

papers.title: Emergent 3D Instance Segmentation from Self-Supervised Point Transformers
papers.authors: Ted Lentsch, Santiago Montiel-Marín, Holger Caesar, Julian F. P. Kooij
papers.tags: instance segmentation, point cloud, autonomous driving, LiDAR
papers.affiliations: Delft University of Technology（代尔夫特理工大学）；University of Alcalá（阿尔卡拉大学）
papers.intro: 本文发现冻结的自监督点云Transformer（Utonia）的内部注意力键（keys）天然蕴含3D实例分割信号，并据此提出无需训练的TokenGraph3D分割器，在无任何几何先验条件下显著优于输出特征基线。

papers.title: MM-BEV: Enhancing Timeliness by Computing Where and When it Matters
papers.authors: Liangkai Liu, Kang G. Shin
papers.tags: autonomous driving, BEV perception, LiDAR, object detection, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Texas Tech University（Liangkai Liu）；University of Michigan（Kang G. Shin）
papers.intro: MM-BEV提出了一种以"计算在何处、何时重要"为原则的实时多模态BEV感知系统，通过将感知任务分解为安全关键（强制）和非关键（可选）部分，结合时间ROI路由、稀疏特征提取、延迟感知协调器和异步调度器，在不损失安全关键精度的前提下大幅降低推理和端到端延迟。

papers.title: NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yiming Fu, Fangjun Li, Xiujin Liu, Ruidong Ma, Hang Yu, Zhichen Lu, Kanwei He, Alessandro Di Nuovo, Angelo Cangelosi, Zhegong Shangguan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, CLIP
papers.affiliations: The University of Manchester, University of Michigan, Tufts University, ENSTA Institut Polytechnique de Paris, Sheffield Hallam University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个认知启发的诊断基准NumerosityVLM，通过正交控制视觉因素和渐进式线索消融，系统评估七个VLM的数量感知能力，并利用多层探针揭示数量信号在视觉编码器早期层出现、而跨模型性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。

papers.title: HistReNeRF: Historic Image Relocalisation within Contemporary Neural Radiance Field Reconstructions
papers.authors: Benjamin T. Hughes, Stuart James
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, NeRF
papers.affiliations: Durham University, Durham, UK
papers.intro: HistReNeRF提出了一种在当代NeRF重建中定位历史照片的框架，通过在DINOv2特征嵌入空间中进行CycleGAN域适应，将历史图像特征映射到当代特征分布，再通过射线-查询匹配估计6-DoF相机位姿。

papers.title: FloodReasonBench: Benchmarking VLM Reasoning Segmentation for Embodied Flood Response at the Edge
papers.authors: Rajat Bhattacharjya, Yoomee Jung, Minwoo Kim, Sing-Yao Wu, Eli Bozorgzadeh, Nalini Venkatasubramanian, Nikil Dutt

papers.affiliations: University of California, Irvine; Kookmin University, South Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出FloodReasonBench基准，结合新的洪水特定推理分割数据集FloodResponseSeg和分层分割推理的系统级评估，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上联合表征了推理分割在资源受限边缘洪水响应场景中的任务准确性与系统资源成本之间的权衡。

papers.title: JoLT: Joint Latent Trajectories for Context-Guided High-Resolution Tiled Generation
papers.authors: Mathis Koroglu, Guillaume Jeanneret, Hugo Caselles-Dupré, Matthieu Cord, Arnaud Dapogny
papers.tags: image generation
papers.affiliations: Obvious Research, Paris, France; Sorbonne Université, CNRS, ISIR, F-75005 Paris, France; Valeo.ai, Paris, France
papers.intro: JoLT提出了一种训练无关的双流联合潜变量轨迹生成框架，通过低分辨率和高分辨率潜变量在每个采样步骤的双向信息交换，实现高分辨率、高细节且全局连贯的图像生成。

papers.title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
papers.authors: Alireza Dehghanpour Farashah, Zhuan Shi, Negar Rostamzadeh, Golnoosh Farnadi
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Mila – Quebec AI Institute, McGill University, Google Research
papers.intro: 本文提出TEA框架，将概念擦除形式化为文本表示空间中的域对齐问题，通过仅微调文本编码器并配合对抗判别器，实现零推理开销、高鲁棒性且跨架构通用的概念擦除。

papers.title: LightLoc++: Sensor-Robust Representation Learning for Efficient Outdoor LiDAR Localization
papers.authors: Wen Li, Shangshu Yu, Dunqiang Liu, Qiming Xia, Sheng Ao, Siqi Shen, Chenglu Wen, Cheng Wang

papers.affiliations: 厦门大学信息学院（Fujian Key Laboratory of Urban Intelligent Sensing and Computing, Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, School of Informatics, Xiamen University）；Wen Li 同时隶属于布里斯托大学（University of Bristol）；Shangshu Yu 隶属于东北大学（Northeastern University）

papers.title: TinyDETR-Pose: Towards End-to-End Real-Time Single-Stage 6DoF Object Pose Estimation with Lightweight Transformers
papers.authors: Paul Julius Kühn, Duc Anh Nguyen, Saptarshi Neil Sinha, Michael Weinmann, Arjan Kuijper

papers.title: FMReward: Aligning and Evaluating Audio-Driven 3D Facial Animation with Human Preferences
papers.authors: Sijing Wu, Yunhao Li, Zhilin Gao, Huiyu Duan, Yucheng Zhu, Guangtao Zhai, Patrick Le Callet

papers.title: Boundary-Aligned Contribution Routing for Robust Optical--SAR Object Detection
papers.authors: Haifa Zhang, Yijing Wang, Haoyu Wang, Zheng Li, Zhiqiang Zuo

papers.title: SpIn-ViT: Designing a Sparsity-Induced Vision Transformer That Is Mechanistically Interpretable
